title: Need For Frequency.
body:
I sincerely commend this app and I am giving it a 5 star as it has helped so far to be consistent. 

However, I am not happy with some of my habits which require twice or three times a month or months such as calling a family member. I need to have it in frequency such as every 10 days so that actual day or date does not remain the same month in mo the out. This means it shows up as an habit to fulfill every 10 days.

The option to choose specific date is okay. But I need frequency, other apps I have tried have this.

title: Start a habit timer on the Apple Watch
body: I like this app sooo much. I’ve tried many habit tracker and when I found this I was happy. However I want to be able to start a timer on my apple watch my habits. Sometimes I keep my phone out of reach to avoid distractions and I use my Apple Watch to log an habit one it’s completed. For an habit where I need to track the time, I have to start the timer on my Apple Watch, do the habit then head over to the app to log it. If there is a way to start the habit timer from my watch, it makes the whole process seamless
